title: Independently audit PR6372 two-anchor scalar boundary and endpoint
body:
## Result
Independently audits PR6372's **changed two-anchor contact block** at exact source b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06, on PR6353. Forward sparse rows and independent reverse functionals agree on **all 592,900 public scalar coefficient positions**, with 874 nonzero entries. All 770 public inputs remain arbitrary.

The local check includes the source's nine existing owned temporaries, both complete unit/off-anchor rows, four response rows and eleven actual dual preparation zero CLEARs. The emitted dual word is bound instruction by instruction as **4759 + 30 + 12934 + 11 + 23**, including fourteen replaced departures and the ordered inverse bases.

The two new **forward** CLEAR rows each have 97 nonzero public coefficients. Their complete functionals are retained; dual zero rows do not grant forward erasure permission. C mixes arbitrary MAIN rows169/193/204, and a control preserves both anchor identities while breaking MAIN204 response support.

Only helper224/227 final frame labels and their two transport records change. A small independent span check verifies the relevant nested dimensions0/4/8/9. The local deltas2H4−2H5 and2H8−2H9 are conditional on the retained native/tariff semantics. Equal scalar matrices do not equate the changed native helper operators. No native-phase/all-width, physical caller, complete price/funding/compiler/outer or newκ admission is claimed; all five framework assumptions remain.

## Evidence
- Eight registered CPython3.12.14 normal/optimized commands; immutable local checkpoint plus two complete endpoint engines, with strict typed receipts.
- Local5/6 and full-word4/4 semantic checks retain concrete coefficient witnesses. These counts are checks per implementation, not distinct newly discovered bugs.
- Package-only read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replay and28 source/typed-receipt rejection controls pass.
- All84 source/candidate pre-CLEAR functionals agree across the implementations; lifetime census41→43, peak13.
- Exact committed bytes/modes, declared ancestry and a self-contained export are checked. Initial orchestration/preflight failures are preserved separately and explained in VALIDATION.md.

[Proof, source pins, exact receipts, commands and remaining obligations](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/027250a7b84349506112b7e8e36f1014848b37cf/research/p104-6372-pair-boundary-audit). Hosted CI and human scientific acceptance are separate.

The [first local checkpoint](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2d650f189913e8c2f2bf5c9012c0c67460a9ac66/research/p104-6372-pair-boundary-audit) remains immutable. This focused result uses two bounded sessions from the donor's ten-session/five-result budget.

Canonical main refreshed unchanged at7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority8, selected6030 unchanged. Full327-open-PR pagination, targeted all-state/source searches and visible handoffs checked; coverage remains bounded/non-atomic. New6375 retains the exact6372 package but changes six other inputs; no present evidence is transferred without rebinding.

Credit Ali Romman, PR6372/6353/6349/6348/6350, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis and the full retained NOTICE lineage. Prior6355's scalar-transpose audit and unpaidmoon's separate stage-one/ordinary findings retain credit. New independent checkers, controls and proof review: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and bounded separately assigned agents; same-session reviews are author-side evidence.

Next: an exact uncovered native/ownership or complete-budget applicability gate. No merge, closure or selected-frontier change; maintainer edits disabled.
